resources.string: This screen is still being built.
Your podcasts. No account, no server needed.
An own.audio account keeps your shows and where you are in them on every device.
Sample shows on a shared own.audio server, no account needed.
The app finds out what answers at the address: own.audio, Audiobookshelf, or a gPodder sync server such as podfetch.
Your own.audio account: its shows, New Episodes and positions on every device.
The podcast libraries of an Audiobookshelf server, with its downloaded episodes and positions.
A gPodder sync account (podfetch, gpodder.net, an own.audio server): this device\'s shows and positions are kept in step with your other players.
Shows you follow on this device need no server. A server adds its own shows; a gPodder account keeps this device\'s in step with your other players.
Its shows leave this device. Nothing changes on the server.
Shows on this device stay; they are no longer kept in step.
Who is in the family, its storage and credit, invitations; and every device signed in to this account.
The server tells the app its other addresses. Add one it doesn\'t know, such as a VPN like Tailscale; on each network the app uses the fastest that answers as this server.
own.audio Podcasts is free and open source (MPL-2.0). It talks only to the feeds you follow, Apple\'s podcast directory and the servers you add.
The shows the family shares on this server are there for everyone in it, each listening from their own position.
New episodes of the shows you follow appear here.
